title: My GitHub Profile Stats configuration
description: What the cards show. Every key is optional: anything left out keeps its default, so a file may name one option or none.

$schema.description: Path to this schema. Leave it alone.

theme.description: auto follows the reader's own light or dark setting; the other two are fixed.

accent.description: Hex color for the icons and the contributions chart. null uses the theme's own. A color too close to the surface is lightened until it is readable, and the run says so.

stats.description: The stats card: the rows, the chart, and how they are drawn.

enabled.description: false skips the card entirely, and makes none of its requests.

output.description: Where to write the SVG, relative to your profile repository. The path this readme embeds.

layout.description: tiles is a grid; mono is one column of larger figures.

icons.description: An Octicon beside each row. null leaves it to the layout.

sparkline.description: The contributions chart under the rows. Reads the contribution calendar, so without the read token it is left out rather than drawn from public days alone.

metrics.description: The rows, in the order they appear. The list both picks them and orders them: a row is on the card because it is named here. null uses the default five.

Total Forks Earned — works without a token

languages.description: The languages card, measured from the files you changed.

enabled.description: false skips the card entirely, and makes none of its requests.

output.description: Where to write the SVG, relative to your profile repository.

pullRequestsToRead.description: How many of your most recent pull requests to read. "all" is the default because a sample does not converge: on one account Terraform read 30% over the most recent 250 and 54% over all 716, a different ranking rather than a rougher one.

exclude.description: Languages to leave out, by name, e.g. ["JSON", "YAML"]. The rest are shared out again over what is left.

manual.description: Declare the languages instead of measuring them: {"Terraform": 54, "TypeScript": 21}. Weights, so percentages or line counts both work. Set, the card makes no request at all. An empty object measures.

top.description: How many languages to name before the rest are folded into Other. Anything under one percent is folded in regardless, because a sliver reads as an artefact.
